target.title: fix(auth): prioritize explicit models.json apiKey over store profiles
target.body:
> [!NOTE]
> **AI-Assisted Contribution:** This PR was prepared and validated with the assistance of an AI coding assistant (Antigravity/Gemini).

## What Problem This Solves
Resolves a problem where the model auth subsystem ignores explicit `apiKey` (literal or SecretRef) overrides in `models.json` if store profiles exist (pr #100839).

**Symptom/Behavior:**
1. Unless `auth: "api-key"` is explicitly set (making `shouldPreferExplicitConfigApiKeyAuth` true), the literal key or SecretRef configured in `models.json` is ignored during the binding phase (falling through `providerEntryBinding` checks). The function then scans the profile store; if any profile is found for the provider, it overrides the user's explicit `apiKey` configuration.
2. Additionally, when a specific profile was requested (e.g. during failover rotation or pinned session), the early check for explicit models.json `apiKey` would bypass profile resolution entirely and return the models.json `apiKey` instead of the rotated profile, causing E2E failover tests (`rotates for overloaded assistant failures across auto-pinned profiles`) to fail.
3. In `models status` and `models auth list` commands, placeholder/marker values in the environment (e.g. `GOOGLE_API_KEY`) were treated as literal keys, causing incorrect `effective=models.json` formatting instead of falling back to store profiles.

Affected locations:
- [resolveApiKeyForProvider](file:///home/dietpi/Developer/openclaw/src/agents/model-auth.ts#L1071-L1084)
- [resolveProviderAuthOverview](file:///home/dietpi/Developer/openclaw/src/commands/models/list.auth-overview.ts#L152-L163)

## Why This Change Was Made
Implemented a surgical fix to resolve the logic discrepancy and test failures:
1. Updated `resolveApiKeyForProvider` to only check and return the configured `apiKey` (either a literal key or a resolved SecretRef) if `profileId` is NOT explicitly requested (`if (!params.profileId && !params.lockedProfile)`).
2. Refactored `isLiteral` in `src/commands/models/list.auth-overview.ts` to exclude non-secret placeholder/marker values using `!isNonSecretApiKeyMarker(...)`, and adjusted the precedence logic so that env-var markers do not override the effective auth early, allowing correct fallback to profiles/env.
3. Updated `resolveUsableCustomProviderApiKey` in `src/agents/model-auth.ts` to correctly filter out environment-resolved placeholder markers.

---

## User Impact
Corrects behavior to ensure that:
1. If a user configures `apiKey` in `models.json` under `models.providers.[provider].apiKey` as a literal API key string or a SecretRef, this configured credential takes precedence over any general auth profiles in the store, unless a specific profile is requested/rotated.
2. In user-facing CLI commands (`models status`), actual placeholder markers correctly fall back to database profiles in format outputs.

---

## Evidence

### Unit Tests / Verification Suite
We wrote three separate reproduction test files covering all scenarios of this behavior, and verified integration failover/rotation tests:
- **Reproduction Happy Path:** [repro_1_1_happy.test.ts](file:///home/dietpi/Developer/openclaw/src/agents/repro_1_1_happy.test.ts) (checks that literal `apiKey` overrides store profiles and resolves the correct label).
- **Reproduction Edge Cases:** [repro_1_1_edge.test.ts](file:///home/dietpi/Developer/openclaw/src/agents/repro_1_1_edge.test.ts) (checks that SecretRef `apiKey` overrides store profiles and falls back to store profiles when resolving fails).
- **Reproduction Stress & Concurrency:** [repro_1_1_stress.test.ts](file:///home/dietpi/Developer/openclaw/src/agents/repro_1_1_stress.test.ts) (checks that concurrent resolution of multiple providers doesn't pollute state or cause race conditions).
- **E2E Rotation & Fallback Tests:** [embedded-agent-runner.run-embedded-agent.auth-profile-rotation.e2e.test.ts](file:///home/dietpi/Developer/openclaw/src/agents/embedded-agent-runner.run-embedded-agent.auth-profile-rotation.e2e.test.ts) and [model-fallback.run-embedded.e2e.test.ts](file:///home/dietpi/Developer/openclaw/src/agents/model-fallback.run-embedded.e2e.test.ts).

### Real Behavior Proof

#### Scenario A — Explicit/resolved apiKey wins over store profiles: Still Allowed ✅
The reproduction tests pass successfully:
